ig_caption:
I deleted the API key from my Docker image. It's still in there. 🔑

AI wrote this Dockerfile:
⚠️ COPY . . brings the .env file in
⚠️ RUN rm .env "removes" it in a later step

Inside the container the file is gone, so it looks safe. But Docker keeps every layer: open the image and the key is right there (layer 6). The delete is just a marker on top (layer 8).
Anyone who can pull your image can do this.

The fix:
✅ never copy the secret in: .env in .dockerignore
✅ copy only the code
✅ pass the key at runtime

Same check → nothing to find.

Save this before your next build 🔖 Follow to see this chatbot reach production 🚀

#docker #devsecops #genai #cloudsecurity #ai
yt_title: Deleted API key is still in my Docker image layers #docker
yt_description:
Docker image layers are permanent. RUN rm .env in a later step only adds a "deleted" marker (whiteout); the file is still in the earlier layer.
Demo (fake key): docker save + tar finds app/.env in layer 6 of the image. Fix: .dockerignore keeps .env out of the build context, COPY only the code, pass the key at runtime; same check finds nothing in 8 layers.

Part of the "AI App to Production" journey: one AI chatbot from laptop to production. Follow along.

#docker #devsecops #genai #cloudsecurity #dockerfile
